NVT Name: MySQL / MariaDB Authentication Bypass (Apr 2012) - Active Check
Summary: MySQL / MariaDB is prone to an authentication bypass.
Specific Result: It was possible to bypass authentication and login as the user 'root'.
Impact:
Successful exploitation will yield unauthorized access to the
  database.
Solution:
Update to:

  - MariaDB version 5.1.62, 5.2.12, 5.3.6, 5.5.23 or later

  - MySQL version 5.1.63, 5.5.24, 5.6.6 or later
Affected Software/OS:
All MariaDB and MySQL versions up to 5.1.61, 5.2.11, 5.3.5,
  5.5.23 are vulnerable.
Vulnerability Detection Method:
Sends various crafted TCP requests and checks the
  responses.
